comment: Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones share the same firmware (MIUI, later HyperOS), so they share this file.

locked.reason: MIUI/HyperOS Security app: handles app permissions, autostart and the permission prompts. Disabling it breaks permissions and can bootloop.
Xiaomi system updater. Removing it is reported to bootloop some devices.
Part of the Security app. Removing it is reported to bootloop.

ecosystems.name: Xiaomi account & Cloud
ecosystems.warning: Xiaomi Cloud backup and sync (photos, contacts, notes) and Xiaomi account sign-in stop working.

ecosystems.name: Xiaomi Share & casting
ecosystems.warning: Xiaomi Share (file sharing with Xiaomi, OPPO and vivo phones) and screen casting stop working.

ecosystems.name: Mi Pay & Xiaomi wallet
ecosystems.warning: Mi Pay, transit cards and Xiaomi wallet features stop working.

featureTags.name: System updates
featureTags.warning: The phone may stop receiving security and system updates. Re-enable before checking for updates.

featureTags.name: Battery & device care
featureTags.warning: Battery management, thermal handling or app sleeping can stop working, which often makes battery life worse.

featureTags.name: Security
featureTags.warning: Removes a security protection. Only do this if you understand what it protects against.

com.miui.msa.global.note: MIUI System Ads: shows ads in Xiaomi system apps.

com.miui.daemon.note: Collects device usage data in the background.

com.miui.android.fashiongallery.note: Wallpaper Carousel / Glance lock screen wallpapers.

com.miui.yellowpage.note: Yellow Pages caller ID for businesses.

com.xiaomi.mipicks.note: GetApps (Xiaomi app store). Some Xiaomi apps update through it.

com.mi.globalbrowser.note: Mi Browser. Make sure another browser is installed.

com.facemoji.lite.xiaomi.note: Facemoji keyboard. Keep it if it is your keyboard.

com.miui.notes.note: Notes. Notes stored only on the phone are deleted with its data.

com.xiaomi.account.note: Xiaomi account: cloud, Find Device and theme store depend on it.

com.xiaomi.xmsf.note: Xiaomi Service Framework: push messages and Xiaomi account services.

com.miui.guardprovider.note: Security scanning engine used by the Security app.

com.miui.securitycore.note: Second space, app lock and security core features.

com.miui.gallery.note: Gallery: the camera opens photos in it.

com.android.thememanager.note: Themes: also applies wallpapers and icons.
